description: Return the complete catalogue record for one Synap model: pricing, context and output limits, supported parameters, quantisation, data-retention policy and readiness. Use this after synap_list_models when you need details the summary leaves out. Free, read-only and needs no API key. Returns the raw model object, or an error naming the id if Synap does not serve it.

model.description: Model id exactly as returned by synap_list_models.

name: synap_get_model
title: Get one Synap model in full
